findings.evidence: Mathlib’s nearby moment lemmas use an observable, e.g. `mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Basic.lean:495` has `integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc ... {X : Ω → ℝ} ... (hm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b)`.
findings.fix: State the general lemma with `{X : Ω → E}`, `hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ`, and `∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖X ω‖ ≤ R`, then derive the current support-of-domain form by taking `X = id`.
findings.issue: `Integrable.exp_norm_smul_of_ae_norm_le` only handles the identity variable on the measure space, so it is less general than the standard Mathlib moment API for a random variable `X : Ω → E`.

findings.evidence: The called theorem is already polymorphic in `β`: `code/TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/BoundedSupportExponential.lean:55` states `{g : ℝ → β}` under `[NormedAddCommGroup β] [NormedSpace 𝕜 β]`.
findings.fix: Generalize the signature to `{𝕜 β : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup β] [NormedSpace 𝕜 β] {g : ℝ → β}` with the same proof.
findings.issue: `integrable_exp_mul_abs_smul_measureT` still restricts `g : ℝ → 𝕜`, although the new lemma it calls works for any normed target space over `𝕜`.

summary: The new bounded-support lemma is useful, but two statements are kept at unnecessarily special levels relative to the API they are meant to expose.
